summary: Iteration 4 backend-only regression + targeted verification of the new Razorpay diagnostic messages. Backend boots cleanly (no syntax errors from _get_razorpay changes). Full regression suite 41/41 passed, plus 4 new unit tests for _get_razorpay diagnostics (45/45 total). POST /api/payments/checkout with placeholder keys now returns HTTP 400 with detail containing 'placeholders', 'Replace' and 'https://dashboard.razorpay.com/app/keys' (previously generic 'Payment gateway error: Authentication failed'). Verify endpoint unchanged: bad signature -> 400 'Invalid payment signature'; valid HMAC(order|payment, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) with no txn -> 404 'Transaction not found'. Auth (register/login admin+client/me/refresh/logout, bcrypt $2b$ hash format), bookings CRUD + ownership, admin CRUD incl. PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}, 403 for client on /api/admin/*, 401 unauth, contact, services listing with INR amounts (39999, 119999, 239999, 7999, 19999, 159999, 399999) and webhook signature validation all pass. No real Razorpay keys used.

minor.issue: Success-path response returns key_id from os.environ['RAZORPAY_KEY_ID'] raw, while _get_razorpay() strips surrounding quotes/whitespace. If .env keeps quotes (as now: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID="rzp_test_..."), the frontend would receive a quoted key and Razorpay Checkout would fail. Reuse the sanitized key_id. Not reachable today because placeholder keys short-circuit.

action_items: Sanitize key_id once in _get_razorpay (or a helper) and return the sanitized value in the checkout response instead of os.environ['RAZORPAY_KEY_ID'].
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — it still documents the old checkout error ('Payment gateway error: Authentication failed') for placeholder keys.
critical_code_review_comments: _get_razorpay() raising HTTPException from a non-route helper is acceptable here, and create_checkout correctly re-raises HTTPException before the generic except — verified no masking of the diagnostic.

Duplicate env sanitization logic: strip/strip-quotes is applied in _get_razorpay but not in verify_payment (os.environ['RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET']) or webhook secret handling; quoted .env values would break HMAC verification. Extract a single _env_key() helper.
seed_data_creation: Suite creates TEST_-style bookings/contacts and an ephemeral second client via /api/auth/register; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (41 tests, API-level) and /app/backend/tests/test_razorpay_diagnostics.py (4 unit tests for _get_razorpay). The checkout placeholder-key assertions were updated this iteration to check for 'placeholder'/'Replace'/'dashboard.razorpay.com' instead of the old 'Authentication failed' string — if real Razorpay test keys are ever added to .env, test_checkout_graceful_400_with_placeholder_keys and TestAdmin::test_update_quote_booking_then_pay will need to expect 200 + order_id instead.
rca_of_the_issue: Original complaint (unhelpful 'Authentication failed') is fixed at the source: _get_razorpay now pre-validates key presence, placeholder substrings, and rzp_test_/rzp_live_ prefix before calling Razorpay, and create_checkout re-raises those HTTPExceptions unmodified. HMAC-based verify/webhook paths are unaffected.
